name: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough silk bandages.
Do you think you can help me out, adventurer?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, adventurer, have you been able to get those twenty silk bandages yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Adventurer, you did it! Thanks to you we are another step closer to achieving our goal with silk bandages. I'll get them stored away, and then we can talk more if you like.
